text:
carmen: quick UX flag on the Access panel — when SSO is enforced the 'Assign role' CTA is disabled and folks are confused. users DM support asking why. thinking of adding a compact edu row under the CTA + a deep-link to the audit feed.
drew: agreed. deep-link is the most useful single action. users want context, not just a disabled state.
isaac: dev note: deep-link pattern looks like /audit?event=role_assignment&role=Admin&src=access_panel. trivial to wire and gives analytics context.
nora: a11y concerns: disabled controls must use aria-disabled and not be repurposed as interactive elements. add a separate keyboard-focusable link under the CTA for 'View audit history' instead of making the disabled CTA clickable. tooltips must use aria-describedby, not title.
a11y-bot: auto-scan: access-panel-frame - issues: disabled CTA removed from tab order; microcopy contrast on proposed edu row borderline in dark mode. Recommend CTA: aria-disabled="true" and tabindex="-1" plus sibling link role="link" with aria-label="Open audit history filtered to role Admin". For tooltip use accessible tooltip pattern and keep visible explanatory text in DOM.
carmen: copy drafts: edu row text: "SSO-managed roles — assignments controlled by your identity provider." link: "View audit history for this role" short tooltip: "Managed by SSO". Also consider a small non-interactive badge 'SSO managed' next to CTA.
drew: product ask: include src param for analytics (src=access-panel) and event property invite_drawer? we'll name it access_panel.audit_click. include role param.
isaac: engineering OK on query params + analytics event; will add unit test to assert query contains role and src. keeping CTA non-interactive is simplest.
nora: accessibility checklist for implementers: 1) CTA aria-disabled and removed from tab order 2) add sibling focusable link with descriptive aria-label 3) edu row copy present in DOM for screen readers 4) color contrast >= 4.5:1 on edu row in both modes 5) avoid title attribute as only tooltip mechanism 6) ensure deep-link landing highlights filtered results and is keyboard-accessible.
carmen: decision: implement edu row + non-interactive badge + sibling deep link. no modal this cycle. I'll update Figma with placement and final copy by Tue EOD. devs pick up next sprint once copy locked.
drew: noted. i'll draft the analytics spec and add the event name access_panel.audit_click with props {role, src}.
a11y-bot: follow-up auto-check to run after PR: keyboard nav test, contrast tests for dark/light themes, tooltip implemented with aria-describedby, and audit link aria-label includes role.
carmen: thanks all 44d i'll post the figma frame and copy variants here when ready.
